headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth, led by TCS and HCLTech, while many peers await results.
summary: TCS reported ₹73,188 cr revenue and a 24% operating margin, up 15.4% YoY. HCLTech posted a 3% QoQ revenue rise and a 21% YoY profit increase, driven by AI sales. Infosys, L&T Mindtree, Wipro and others have not released results, leaving the sector picture incomplete. Guidance from Wipro suggests flat revenue in the next quarter.

themes.title: AI as a growth driver
themes.detail: Both TCS and HCLTech highlighted AI revenue, with TCS reaching $3.1 bn and HCLTech’s AI revenue jumping 78% YoY.

themes.title: Profit momentum
themes.detail: HCLTech’s profit rose 21% YoY and TCS maintained a 24% operating margin, indicating strong cost control.

themes.title: Guidance uncertainty
themes.detail: Wipro retained a flat‑revenue outlook and many peers have not disclosed guidance, adding uncertainty for Q3.

leaders.why: Highest revenue and strong margin, with 15.4% YoY growth.
Significant profit rise and AI‑driven revenue growth.

laggards.why: Guidance expects flat revenue and no results released yet.
